children: The DAX 40 fell about 0.7% to around 23,390 on Monday, ending a four-day rally that had pushed the index to record highs last week and underperforming its European peers.

Renewed US-Iran strikes in the Middle East and a hawkish inflation stance from Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh in his Friday speech at Jackson Hole weighed on market sentiment, pushing oil prices and bond yields higher.
On the data front, the release of inflation data was in focus today.
Most sectors traded in the red, led by industrials.
Siemens Energy led losses among stocks, dropping over 4%, with MTU Aero Engines and Heidelberg Materials falling more than 1% each.

title: DAX on Negative Note
